title: Ivanti Connect Secure: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 5 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.
The product faces the internet or gives remote access.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Nov 2, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
